WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
), shares AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           order_count,
           CAST(order_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share
    FROM account_order_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
